reason: AXISCADES Technologies is acquiring Cloud Wave Technologies, which is expected to accelerate its entry into aerospace manufacturing and expand its market opportunity.
why_now: The company announced this acquisition via a press release on August 30, 2026, providing a fresh catalyst for the stock.
source_headlines: AXISCADES Technologies Limited: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 30, 2026, titled "AXISCADES Technologies to Acquire Cloud Wave Technologies, Accelerating Entry into Aerospace Manufacturing".
